prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - maximize carbohydrate intake for sustained energy and endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan provides 55-65% of daily calories from carbohydrates to support endurance training
Includes 4-5 eating occasions distributed throughout the day for sustained energy
Total daily calories appropriate for a 68 kg endurance athlete in training (approximately 2,400-2,800 calories)
Specifies realistic food quantities and meal timing relative to training
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and sustained energy throughout the day

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains from weightlifting training

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions with protein distributed evenly (minimum 30g per meal)
Total daily protein intake meets or exceeds 1.8g per kg of body weight
Includes carbohydrates around training windows to support performance and recovery
All meals are practical, compact, and completable within a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) focusing on protein distribution and muscle recovery nutrition across meals

prompt_inputs.goal: Fuel a 120-minute road cycling training session with optimal energy distribution and hydration

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes pre-ride, during-ride, and post-ride nutrition timed appropriately around the 120-minute training session
Hydration strategy specified with fluid intake volumes and timing
All meals and snacks are vegetarian and nut-free
Caloric and macronutrient content supports sustained cycling performance for the duration specified
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (cyclist) emphasizing fueling strategy around training timing and hydration needs

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and improve endurance for competitive cycling

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day
All meals are vegetarian with no peanut-containing ingredients
Adequate protein intake from alternative sources (legumes, dairy, nuts excluding peanuts, seeds)
Macronutrient distribution supports muscle building and endurance training goals
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with dietary restriction constraints (vegetarian athlete or athlete with food allergies) requiring alternative protein and nutrient sources

prompt_inputs.goal: Competition day nutrition - maximize energy availability while maintaining digestibility 2 hours before event start

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans full day with 4-5 eating occasions
Pre-competition meal (2 hours before) is easily digestible and carbohydrate-focused
Total daily calories and macronutrient distribution support competition performance
All dietary restrictions are respected throughout the day
